## Local calibration

::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/package/single_observation_calibration.png){fig-alt="A published AGB curve calibrated with one observation." fig-align="center"}

::: {.figure-caption}
**One observation** – a shrinkage-based level anchor, not a locally learned trajectory.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/package/multiple_observation_calibration.png){fig-alt="A published AGB curve calibrated with five observations." fig-align="center"}

::: {.figure-caption}
**Several observations** – more evidence for the local level while the age-dependent shape remains fixed.
:::
:::
:::


::: notes
Calibration alters magnitude, not growth shape. A single point informs a cautious BLUP
adjustment. Several points provide stronger evidence. Neither case estimates a new
temporal response.
:::

## Local calibration

<video data-autoplay loop muted playsinline src="images/local-calibration/RSYC_curveAssign_4trajectories_AGB_vs_AGB_RSYC_maps_with_trajectories_animation.mp4" style="display:block; margin:0 auto; width:100%; max-height:720px; object-fit:contain;"></video>

::: notes
Curves are assigned to each pixel/segment and calibrated with the annual AGB
observations, producing temporally consistent AGB trajectories.
:::

::: {.text60}
Annual AGB time series derived from locally calibrated RSYC curves (1984–2024, 30 m) will be openly available for download.

*In review:* Tompalski, P., Hermosilla, T., Baral, S., White, J.C., Wulder, M.A., Riofrio, J., 2026. **Reconciling remote sensing observations and forest growth dynamics to derive spatially explicit and temporally consistent annual aboveground biomass trajectories for Canada's forests**. Submitted to Forest Ecology and Management on 2026-10-01.
:::

::: notes
National map of temporally calibrated AGB, a 5 × 5 km subset showing the original and
calibrated time series, and example pixel trajectories.
:::
